provenance.label: CULVER CITY (held-out domain shift; secondary, D-72; unseen town, simulated sensor)
provenance.preregistration_version: v3.2 (supersedes v3.1 runs/20261024-E5/preregistration_v3_1.json only by D-71; v1, v2, v3 and v3.1 kept unchanged)

figures.name: 01_headline
figures.title: Headline: mean ΔAP@0.7 over the 4 original attacks
figures.caption: Each defense's mean change in AP@0.7 against no defense, over spoof/remove/shift (feature) and spoof (points). Dot = point estimate; thick line = 95% CI from the scenario bootstrap (the pre-registered primary CI); thin line = 10-frame-block bootstrap. Ego-only is far off-scale and is listed in the table only.

figures.name: 02_per_family
figures.title: ΔAP@0.7 per condition: clean and original attacks
figures.caption: Every non-PGD condition × defense, both AP definitions, 95% CI from the scenario bootstrap. Ego-only in the table only.

figures.name: 02b_per_family_pgd
figures.title: ΔAP@0.7 per condition: optimized (PGD) attacks
figures.caption: As 2a for the PGD conditions, on its own scale (PGD effects are much larger than the original attacks').

figures.name: 03_clean_cost
figures.title: Clean cost (relative AP@0.7 loss)
figures.caption: Relative AP@0.7 loss on clean frames. The pre-registered success rule requires B-RAY's scenario-CI high ≤ 1% under both AP definitions.

figures.name: 04_r1_minus_bray
figures.title: Key secondary: R1 − B-RAY
figures.caption: Paired difference R1 − B-RAY in ΔAP@0.7, the pre-registered means and each non-PGD condition. Each panel quotes the statement the frozen analysis emitted.

figures.name: 04b_r1_minus_bray_pgd
figures.title: R1 − B-RAY under PGD attacks
figures.caption: Paired difference per PGD condition (descriptive; not part of the key secondary).

figures.name: 05_pgd_recovery
figures.title: PGD attacks: recovery
figures.caption: Recovery = ΔAP@0.7 / attack loss per optimized-attack condition. n/a when the attack loss is < 0.005.

figures.name: 06_bnorm_catch
figures.title: B-NORM catch rate
figures.caption: Share of frames with a sender in which B-NORM flags the attacker; on 'clean' this is the false-flag rate.

figures.name: 07_attack_strength
figures.title: Attack strength
figures.caption: Attack loss per condition over all frames (with CI) and over the frames where the attack was realized.

figures.name: 08_bray_boxes
figures.title: B-RAY removals
figures.caption: Boxes B-RAY removed, split by whether they matched a real car.

figures.name: 09_r1_units
figures.title: R1 gating against ground truth
figures.caption: Contributions (sender × 6.4 m tile) R1 switched off, by their ground-truth label.

figures.name: 10_by_agents
figures.title: Effect by number of cars
figures.caption: Mean ΔAP@0.7 over the 4 original attacks per agent count (frozen v2 analysis, frame-order AP).

note: Every number is copied from the input analysis JSON files; nothing is recomputed.
